    def get_interesting_exponents(limit: int) -> list[int]:

        a few small coprimes. The previous version missed important factors like 5|15.

        # Include all proper factors (critical for constant-monomial high-k)

        # Include a few coprimes spread across the range (distance / orbit mixing)
        cop = [k for k in range(1, limit) if gcd(k, limit) == 1]

            bs.add((-a) % limit)

            for b in bs:
                if b != a:
                    pairs.append(sorted([a, b]))

        # Deduplicate

        seen_p: set[tuple[int, int]] = set()

            tp = (p[0], p[1])
            if tp not in seen_p:

                unique.append(p)
